current: Rear fog lamps on motor vehicles are the subject of this regulation, which establishes approval requirements governing their construction, performance, and installation to ensure adequate visibility in conditions of poor visibility.
proposed: Sets approval requirements for rear fog lamps for vehicles of categories L3, L4, L5, L7, M, N, O and T, including marking, photometric performance, colour and conformity of production.

current: UN Regulation No. 45 sets uniform provisions for approval of headlamp cleaners and of vehicles with regard to headlamp cleaners. A headlamp cleaner approved as a component may optionally be installed. Text incorporates Supplement 11 to the 01 series of amendments (in force 10 October 2017).
proposed: Sets approval provisions for headlamp cleaners and for vehicle types with regard to headlamp cleaners. A manufacturer may install a cleaner previously approved as a component, but separate component approval is not mandatory. Text incorporates Supplement 11 to the 01 series of amendments (in force 10 October 2017).
evidence: In this case it is possible, at the manufacturer’s choice, to install a headlamp cleaner previously approved as a component, but this previous approval is not mandatory
